chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Whoever builds a dwelling, let him slaughter a fat ram and feed its meat to the poor. Then he should say: O Allah, avert from me the castaways of the Jinn, humans, and devils, and bless us in our homes, and he will be given what he asked for.'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended ritual and supplication for consecrating a new home in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith establishes the ritual of 'Aqeeqah' or home consecration, emphasizing the dual spiritual and social benefits of distributing meat to the needy while invoking divine protection. The supplication specifically targets 'Mardat al-Jinn' (the mischief of Jinn), reflecting the Shia emphasis on seeking refuge from unseen forces through prophetic tradition. This practice underscores the integration of material well-being with spiritual purification in domestic spaces.
